# US-SPURS Change Submission

## Purpose

Describe the problem, requirement, or mission need addressed by this change.

## Changes

Describe the documentation, configuration, process, or system changes included.

## Validation

- [ ] Content or code was reviewed locally.
- [ ] Links and navigation were checked.
- [ ] Tests, linting, or build validation were run where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, protected personal data, or sensitive operational information were added.
- [ ] Related documentation was updated.

## Impact

### Operational Impact

Describe any effect on users, missions, procedures, or partner workflows.

### Technical Impact

Describe architecture, dependencies, compatibility, deployment, or maintenance effects.

### Security and Privacy Impact

Describe new permissions, data handling, trust boundaries, or security considerations. Write `None identified` only after review.

## Evidence

Provide screenshots, logs, test output, document previews, or other validation evidence when relevant.

## Related Work

Link related issues, decisions, documents, or pull requests.

## Reviewer Notes

Call out areas requiring specialized documentation, operational, technical, security, or leadership review.
